newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Riksbank says crown fundamentally undervalued.
newsitem.headline: Riksbank says crown fundamentally undervalued.

text.p: Sweden's Riksbank said on Thursday that the crown was fundamentally undervalued at a nominal 119 on the Trade Currency Weighted (TCW) index.
The crown is currently weaker at around 123 on the TCW index.

"The crown is fundamentally undervalued at this level of 119 on the TCW index," the head of the bank's economic department, Claes Berg, told a press conference after the Riksbank released its quarterly inflation report.
The bank estimated that the crown has been on average at 119.4 on the TCW index so far this year.
The Riksbank has previously said that it saw 118 as the top of the range, in real terms, at which the crown should be trading.
